news.title: Nieuws: Schuberg Philis en het Verbond bundelen krachten voor een IT-weerbare verzekeringssector

summary: Schuberg Philis. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 9 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: Dutch IT and cloud operations company near Schiphol; senior roles in English, IND sponsor, and frequent visa mentions.

culture.text: 8 of its 9 jobs are in Schiphol-Rijk, mostly senior, in IT, cloud and security and project management.
Says it is the only Dutch-based Akamai Platinum partner, serving top financial services and retail companies.

open.text: Schuberg Philis B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
None of its 9 jobs here require Dutch and 44% mention visa or relocation.
Jobs draw about 197 applicants each on LinkedIn on average, so expect competition.

growth.text: Teamed up with the Dutch insurers' association (het Verbond) to make the insurance sector more IT-resilient.
